purpose: Teach: 盛り込ま/所定/同月/両側/過大/前々/附属/米ドル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文には新たな知見が盛り込まれる工夫を
lines.en: Ren — I want to see fresh insights woven into the paper itself.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Opens with the name as an anchor. Leans slightly forward on the instruction. Patient but expecting full comprehension. Quiet authority, not raising volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。所定のフォーマットを守ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep to the required format.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Quick, clear. Not deferential but genuinely attentive — he's taking the notes seriously. Even pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、同月内に中間報告を出せ
lines.en: Ren — get me an interim report by the end of this month.
lines.style: Crisp, specific. The timeline lands with weight. Not unkind, but non-negotiable. Slight pause before the deadline, like a checkpoint being marked.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説の両側からデータを集めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll gather data from both sides of the hypothesis.
lines.style: Earnest commitment. Speaks carefully, as if walking through the logic aloud. Steady, methodical. Shows he's already thinking ahead to the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、過大な期待をデータに寄せるな
lines.en: Ren — don't load all your hopes onto the data.
lines.style: Softer than before, almost cautionary. Leans back slightly. The warning of someone who's seen young researchers fall into this trap. Warm but serious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。前々から取り組んでいるテーマを深めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll deepen the work I've been building on since before.
lines.style: Quiet reassurance in his tone. He understands the caution — not defensive, reflective. Shows he's thought about this angle already. Steady and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、大学附属病院との共同研究も視野に入れろ
lines.en: Ren — keep the university hospital's joint research in your sights too.
lines.style: Expanding the scope. Matter-of-fact, but with an opening quality — he's offering a door. Not urgent, but significant. Expects Ren to recognize the opportunity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。米ドル建て研究費の管理にも気を配ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll also manage the funding carefully — including the dollar-denominated research budget.
lines.style: Alert, precise. He's showing he's tracking multiple moving parts. No strain in his voice, just clarity. The closing moment: he's confirmed he's listening on all fronts.
